buddhist_sakra.name: Battle standard
buddhist_sakra.notes: Recollection of his standard is proposed as reassurance to the devas in battle; the sutta contrasts this with refuge in the Buddha, Dhamma and Sangha.

sources.reference: Saṃyutta Nikāya 11.3, Dhajagga Sutta, Thanissaro translation

attributes.name: Elephant mount and single-pronged vajra
attributes.notes: The early Heian image at Tōji depicts Taishakuten seated on an elephant, one leg lowered, holding a single-pronged vajra.

sources.reference: JAANUS, s.v. Taishakuten, iconography at Tōji
